_PAGE_FILTER_PERCENT_DESCRIPTION_: The function filterPercent formats a value as a percentage, e.g. "15,30 %". It uses filterFloat.
_PAGE_FILTER_PERCENT_ARGUMENTS_DIGIT_GRO: Whether digit grouping separators are shown
_PAGE_FILTER_PERCENT_ARGUMENTS_IS_FRACTI: Whether the value is a fraction (0.153 → 15,30 %) and not a percentage (15.3 → 15,30 %)
